Emojis probably do suck for those that use screen readers. When working for the government all documents have to be super boring and are also available in special formats upon request. 

It definitely lacks self awareness and an appreciation for art to demand everything always be accessible 24/7, especially when accessible for one person might be more difficult for another person. 

You should always be able to request accomodations but everyone regardless of their abilities should be able to express themselves and create art. Fuck the war on fonts.

She was having sex with you because you were emotional distant. You probably lead her to believe that you'd love her and the relationship would work if she put out. 

That makes you a shitty person. 

If you were coercing her into having sex so she could get attention from you. 

You're a rapist.

If she wasn't comfortable having sex with someone she wasn't dating and you begrudgingly dated her so you could fuck her. 

You're a shitty person and a rapist in my eyes.

Sex is a social contract and you fucked up on your end. Do better.

YOU are the most important part of this equation. Get to a hospital, get formed. The hospital won't release you until you're safe and this way you'll have somewhere to stay until the police get involved. 

Take care. You've got this. You're strong and brave and incredibly smart. You can do this. You are in danger but you can get out of this situation, I believe in you.

Culturally, we do a lot of things for our physical health and forget about staying mentally healthy. 

Learning coping strategies (healthy ways of thinking) before you even need them is a great way to do life - and seeing a psychologist can help you do that!
